mentions.h: Dramatic Inter-County win for Greg Billington

photos.c: Kris Gauson (1530) in the colours of Scotland East is in the front rank of the U20 Men's 8 km race. The eventual winner was Lee Carey (1597 Warwickshire) from Adam Hickey (1359 Essex) with Kris 6th and therefore qualifying for the GBR team to go to the IAAF World Champs in Fukuoka, Japan.
